_verification.verified_2026-10-06_against: Wikipedia, 'List of Billboard number-one R&B albums of <year>' for 1970 to 1979 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Billboard_number-one_R%26B_albums_of_1970 and the matching pages for each later year); week_start equals the Wikipedia issue date.
_verification.what_this_is: Weekly number-one albums on Billboard's R&B/Soul albums chart. Albums only, never singles.
_verification.corrections: Removed 7 filler rows (week_start 1972-08-26 to 1972-10-07) because Billboard suspended the R&B albums chart from August 26 to October 7, 1972. Corrected the album for 51 other weeks (mostly 1972, plus 1977). Corrected weeks_at_number_one is now a count within each consecutive run. fun_fact was cleared (null) on every corrected row because the old text described the wrong album, and also on any other row whose text stated a week count, run or ordinal, because those statements were built from the wrong data. The 'week' field keeps the original calendar week number, so 1972 skips the suspension weeks.
_verification.not_verified: Remaining fun_fact text carries no week counts or run claims but was not checked against a source.
